status: extracted structure (components and dependencies); declared flows and drawing choices are labelled
produced_by: ComponentViewTest (journal-ocsf-writer test scope) with ArchUnit 1.5.0 over compiled production classes

scope.classes: production classes only (test classes excluded); nested and anonymous classes belong to their top-level class

relationship: A depends on B when a class of A refers directly to a class of B in bytecode: a call, field access, construction, inheritance, member or parameter type, or annotation. It is a static reference, not evidence that the path executed.

components.name: Capture and replay entry points
components.membership: named classes in io.github.markpollack.journal.ocsf.writer: CliCapture, LiveCapture, OcsfWriterTool, Replay
components.responsibility: Acquires a CLI's native output (launching the CLI, reading standard input, or replaying a recording) and feeds it, with arrival times, to the run writer; carries the process outcome and archives the native session file unchanged.

components.name: Run writer
components.membership: named classes in io.github.markpollack.journal.ocsf.writer: OcsfRunWriter
components.responsibility: Records one run: accepts each declared source, frames it, selects its compatibility entry, hands each record to the source's mapper and routes the resulting events to the root core or a child core; owns flush, complete, interrupt and failure.

components.name: Source input and run facts
components.membership: named classes in io.github.markpollack.journal.ocsf.writer: SourceInput, SourceDescriptor, RunDescriptor, WriterOptions
components.responsibility: The capture-facing input interface (byte chunks or whole records, each with the arrival time the caller observed) and the facts declared before input: the run, each source's identity and route, and writer settings.

components.name: Framing and native records
components.membership: named classes in io.github.markpollack.journal.ocsf.writer: LineFramer, NativeRecord
components.responsibility: Splits arbitrary byte chunks into lines and classifies each line before interpretation (parsed, malformed, undecodable, blank, incomplete); nothing is dropped.

components.name: Compatibility selection
components.membership: named classes in io.github.markpollack.journal.ocsf.writer: Compatibility, VersionBootstrap
components.responsibility: Chooses at most one registry entry (source description, mapping contract, Java mapper) per source from the CLI, profile, route and version, reading only the version-bearing record before selection; no match means the input is retained, not interpreted.

components.name: Source mappers
components.membership: classes implementing SourceMapper, plus SourceMapper, MapperSupport, SourceContext, CodexItems, UsageTranches, MappingContracts, ClaudeMcp, AntigravityMcp, McpObservations
components.responsibility: Interpret one native record at a time under the selected mapping contract into OCSF-extension events or whole-record retention, naming the contract rule each event executes.

components.name: MCP protocol binding
components.membership: named classes in io.github.markpollack.journal.ocsf.writer: McpBinding, McpEmbedder, McpAlternatives, McpNode, McpSchemaModel, McpUnionMatch, McpAllOf, McpBindingNames, McpBindingGenerator, McpGeneratedFiles, McpCoverage
components.responsibility: Generates the typed mcp_* objects and the binding table from the pinned official MCP JSON Schemas, embeds a protocol object or a CLI's partial projection into them losslessly, and names the official definitions a file must declare to be read offline.

components.name: Core persistence
components.membership: named classes in io.github.markpollack.journal.ocsf.writer: CoreWriter, Declarations, DefinitionClosure, ProtocolDeclarations
components.responsibility: Writes each core's self-describing events.jsonl (declarations before the events that need them, then events) and its ancillary run.json, keeping a readable prefix at every flush and hashing what is on disk at finalization.

components.name: Schema and toolchain pins
components.membership: named classes in io.github.markpollack.journal.ocsf.writer: SchemaPin, Pins, SchemaExcerpt
components.responsibility: The pinned compiled OCSF schema (class and category ids are read, never hand-written) and the checksummed toolchain every package names.

components.name: Lexically exact JSON (writer)
components.membership: named classes in io.github.markpollack.journal.ocsf.writer: Jv
components.responsibility: The writer's own JSON value: numbers keep their spelling, member order is kept, duplicates are rejected; Jackson's tokenizer does the lexing and nothing else of Jackson is used.

components.name: Package reader
components.membership: named classes in io.github.markpollack.journal.tck: ocsf.PackageReader, ocsf.DeclaredFile, ocsf.OcsfPackage, ocsf.RunManifest, ocsf.Event, ocsf.Diagnostic, ocsf.SchemaCatalog, ocsf.CompatibilityHistory, ocsf.SemanticContract, ocsf.SemanticOperation, ocsf.McpProtocol, schema.McpValidation
components.responsibility: Opens a run package from events.jsonl alone (or its directory), verifies pins and hashes, and exposes declarations, events, children and explicit diagnostics; it never fetches a registry or loads production classes.

components.name: Independent oracle
components.membership: named classes in io.github.markpollack.journal.tck: ocsf.OcsfOracle, ocsf.OracleReport, ocsf.ExpectedSources, ocsf.Reconstruction, ocsf.McpChecks
components.responsibility: Judges a saved package against what its frozen native artifacts report: populations, ownership by declared ids, exact values, retention and acquisition, with DEFECTIVE, UNRESOLVED and UNSUPPORTED kept apart.

components.name: Source profiles
components.membership: classes implementing SourceProfile, plus SourceProfile, ExpectedFacts, TrancheReading, McpReadings
components.responsibility: State, from a native artifact's records alone and independently of the writer's mappers, which facts it reports: the expected population and exact values per fact family.

components.name: Analysis views
components.membership: named classes in io.github.markpollack.journal.tck: ocsf.AnalysisViews, ocsf.PackageMeasure
components.responsibility: Compute the named deterministic operations a package's semantic contract declares from the saved core alone, and measure a core's bytes.

components.name: Reader command line
components.membership: named classes in io.github.markpollack.journal.tck: ocsf.OcsfReaderTool
components.responsibility: The inspect, views, measure, reconstruct, self-contained and verify commands, with exit statuses that keep refusal, defects and incompleteness apart.

components.name: Neutral JSON, bytes and check ledger
components.membership: named classes in io.github.markpollack.journal.tck: verify.Json, verify.NeutralJson, verify.Difference, verify.Check, verify.CheckLedger, verify.CheckReport, ocsf.NativeArtifact
components.responsibility: Vendor-neutral reading: JSON through Jackson's tokenizer only with exact numbers, native artifacts read as bytes first with every line kept, hashing, and the check outcomes and ledger every verifier reports with.

components.name: Earlier-format Claude stream verifier
components.membership: named classes in io.github.markpollack.journal.tck: verify.CandidatePackage, verify.ClaudeStreamContract, verify.ClaudeStreamOracle, verify.ClaudeStreamVerifier, verify.VerificationReport
components.responsibility: Verifies packages of the earlier journal-core format produced by claude-code-capture against their Claude stream; not on the OCSF writer's path.

components.name: Native inventory tools
components.membership: package io.github.markpollack.journal.tck.ocsf.inventory
components.responsibility: Empirical variant/path inventories of native artifacts and their comparison with the accepted source specifications; findings are proposals, never applied.

components.name: Prototype candidate support
components.membership: package io.github.markpollack.journal.tck.ocsf.prototype
components.responsibility: NON-PRODUCTION support that produces candidate packages from the earlier Python prototype's layout; it is producer-side code and the oracle never uses it.

components.name: Value-landing comparison
components.membership: package io.github.markpollack.journal.tck.venn
components.responsibility: Counts which native values reappear anywhere in a journal record, read from the data rather than parser code; an exploratory measure, not an oracle check.
